# Find A Temp

> Find A Temp (findatemp.ie) is a Dublin temporary staffing service run by Real People Recruitment. Employers can browse profiles of vetted temps who are available now across Dublin, filtered by area and job category, and request a CV, an interview or a temporary trial with as little as 1 day's notice. There are no upfront fees for employers.

Find A Temp is operated by Real People Recruitment, a Dublin recruitment agency established in 2015 with over 15 years of industry experience. The temp service launched in 2020.

How it works for employers:
- Browse available temps by Dublin area and category, and see each temp's hourly rate, availability and experience.
- Request a CV, an interview or a temporary trial directly from a profile. No upfront fees.
- Find A Temp can arrange interviews and offer letters, employ the temp and run weekly payroll, including Revenue registration, payslips, tax and reference checks.

Categories covered: catering, cleaning and facilities, construction and trades, customer service, driving and logistics, events and promo, healthcare and social care, hospitality, office and admin, production, retail, security, warehouse.

Coverage: Dublin city (Dublin 1 to Dublin 24), County Dublin, and nearby towns including Maynooth, Leixlip and Celbridge.

For job seekers: people looking for temporary work in Dublin can register free and set their areas, availability and hourly rate.

Contact: +353 1 254 4273, gerard@findatemp.ie, The Brickhouse, Block 1, Mount Street Lower, Dublin 2.

## Employers
- [Browse available temps](https://www.findatemp.ie/browse): search all temps available now across Dublin

- [About Find A Temp](https://www.findatemp.ie/about): company background and the full service
- [Testimonials](https://www.findatemp.ie/testimonials): feedback from employers and temps
